caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a lidded tankard or mug with an ornate handle and a decorative band near its base. The illustration is rendered in shades of gray on a beige, slightly stained background that shows areas of yellowing and brownish spots, especially near the edges. The tankard is cylindrical, tapering slightly toward the bottom, and has a prominent, rounded lid with a raised central section and a thumb lever for opening. The handle is large, curling outward and downward, and appears to be made of metal, with a small decorative element and a hinge connecting it to the lid. Near the bottom edge of the tankard is a band of repeated ornamental motifs that resemble small clusters or bead-like shapes. The shading and highlights give the object a metallic appearance, and the drawing is highly detailed around the handle and lid, while the body of the tankard is rendered more simply. No other objects or figures are present in the composition.
title: Silver Tankard
